title: Independent reading: John 10:1–18
subtitle: Follow an extended image and its explanatory claims.
overview: John 10 develops a sustained image through repeated vocabulary, contrast, and explanatory self-identification. Track repetitions before looking for a single compressed interpretation.
Relative and purpose clauses specify the sheep, the shepherd’s action, and the claimed result.

items.grc: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός.
ἐγὼ ἦλθον ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχωσιν καὶ περισσὸν ἔχωσιν.
items.en: I came so that they may have life and may have it abundantly.
